text:
Maria Torres: Good morning — quick desk briefing before handoff. Queue: 39 (↑12). P1: 1 (webhook failures), P2: 5, P3: 33. TL;DR: one customer-facing P1, some macro gaps for the webhook flow. Details below.

Jae Kim: Taking the P1. Seeing a surge of 502/504 from webhooks-proxy around 02:10 UTC. Errors look like downstream timeouts to webhook consumer.

Leo Patel: Confirmed. Logs show repeated `upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream` from nginx. Affected tenant IDs: t-112, t-504.

Sam Nguyen: Oncall here — I can spin up the fallback relay for those tenants while you dig in. Activating fallback routing now via the console rule. @Jae please post the request IDs you want me to trace. :wrench:

Jae Kim: Thanks Sam. First few request ids: `req-20260317-0031a`, `req-20260317-0031b`. I pasted a short curl for reproduction: ```bash
curl -v -H 'X-Tenant: t-112' -d '{"event":"ping"}' https://hooks.redwood.example/webhook
```

Leo Patel: Also seeing an edge 5xx coming from `aurora-consumer-prod` at the same window. I suspect a transient DB connection pool exhaustion. Metrics: p95 latency for aurora spikes to ~4.2s at 02:12 UTC.

Maria Torres: Action items: 1) Jae to confirm whether consumer is overloaded or network blip. 2) Sam to hold fallback routing until we have trace results. 3) Leo/infra to look at connection pool config. 4) Support to update macro for P1 webhook issue.

Jae Kim: I'll run a tail on consumer logs and try a couple of repros. If it's pool exhaustion I'll add a short-term increase to pool_size=50 and monitor.

Leo Patel: I'm checking the DB side. If we bump pool_size, we should also check RDS CPU — don't want to flip pressure to the DB.

Maria Torres: Macro update request — current P1 macro text doesn't include fallback instruction. Suggest edit: "If webhooks return 5xx/504 across >10% of requests in 5m, enable fallback routing and notify infra." Can someone submit a PR to macros repo?

Sam Nguyen: I can open the PR now. Will include the exact console step and links to the temporary routing rule.

ops-bot: deploy event — `redwood-webhooks-prod` rolling restart scheduled by deploy-bot at 02:30 UTC for 2 nodes (automated).

Jae Kim: Noted. If restart happens, we'll coordinate and pause routing changes until post-restart check.

Maria Torres: Support queue notes for next shift: - Volume is higher because of webhook spikes; prioritize P1 and related P2s. - Update affected customers with the temporary mitigation note once fallback is stable. - Macro PR: @Sam to link it here when opened.

Sam Nguyen: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/macros/pulls/88 — includes updated P1 webhook text and a short checklist.

Leo Patel: Quick FYI: I'll test a pool_size bump in staging and post results in the infra channel.

Maria Torres: Thanks all. Handoff to evening team: @Jae, please drop a 1-line update after you confirm root cause or after restart. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Rolling restart started for `redwood-webhooks-prod-1` (node 1/2).

Jae Kim: Copy that. Will update after traces and postmortem notes.

Maria Torres: End of thread — small followups only. Good job moving quickly.
